name: Microcat EPC
description: The industry-leading electronic parts catalog (EPC) covering 50+ vehicle brands. Advanced VIN decoding, exploded-view diagrams, and real-time parts lookup used by 250,000+ users across 186 countries.

name: Microcat Pro
description: Mobile-first parts query solution for technicians on the workshop floor. Offline-capable catalog access, barcode scanning, and instant parts identification from any device.

name: SimplePart
description: Complete dealer-to-consumer ecommerce platform. Integrated shopping cart, secure payments, live inventory sync, and branded storefronts that turn parts catalogs into online revenue.

name: Superservice Connect
description: Online service booking and appointment management. Customers self-book service slots, while workshops optimize bay utilization with smart scheduling and automated reminders.

name: Superservice Menus
description: Professional quote and service menu generator. Standardized pricing for every service operation, transparent customer quotes, and consistent margin control across your dealer network.

name: Superservice Triage
description: Guided workshop inspection and vehicle triage. Digital multi-point inspection, photo documentation, and automated customer-friendly condition reports that drive service upsell.

name: Infodrive
description: Enterprise analytics platform for automotive aftermarket. Real-time KPI dashboards, parts demand forecasting, and customer behavior insights powered by your dealership data.

name: Intellegam Assistants
description: AI-powered virtual assistants for parts and service. Natural language parts lookup, 24/7 customer service chatbots, and intelligent service recommendation engines.

name: Microcat EPC EU Edition
description: European-market edition of Microcat EPC with localized VIN data, EU supplier pricing, multi-currency support, and compliance with European vehicle homologation standards.

name: Microcat Pro APAC
description: Asia-Pacific edition of Microcat Pro. Localized for right-hand and left-hand drive markets, with regional language support and APAC distributor inventory integration.

name: SimplePart Plus
description: Premium tier of SimplePart with advanced merchandising, B2B account portals, dynamic pricing rules, multi-warehouse routing, and integrated marketing automation.

name: Superservice Connect Pro
description: Pro edition with multi-location scheduling, technician skill matching, loaner vehicle management, and customer loyalty program integration for high-volume service centers.

name: Superservice Menus Lite
description: Lightweight quote generator for independent workshops. Core service menu templates, simple PDF quotes, and essential pricing management at an entry-level price point.

name: Superservice Triage AI
description: AI-enhanced triage with computer-vision damage detection, automated estimate generation, and predictive repair recommendations that increase workshop efficiency by 30%.

name: Infodrive Premium
description: Premium analytics suite with predictive demand modeling, custom report builder, API access for BI tools, and dedicated data warehouse for large dealer groups.

name: Infodrive Starter
description: Entry-level analytics for single-location workshops. Pre-built sales, service, and inventory dashboards with monthly trends and simple export to CSV and PDF.

name: Intellegam Assistants Pro
description: Enterprise AI assistant with custom training on your parts catalog, multi-language support, voice-enabled service booking, and deep CRM integration for dealer groups.

name: Microcat Fleet
description: Fleet-focused parts catalog for commercial vehicle operators. Multi-vehicle lookup, bulk parts ordering, fleet-wide service scheduling, and total cost of ownership tracking.

name: SimplePart Mobile
description: Mobile-optimized ecommerce storefront with native app experience, push notifications for order status, one-tap reordering, and mobile payment integration.

name: Superservice Workshop
description: Complete workshop management platform combining booking, triage, menus, and technician dispatch in one integrated suite designed for high-throughput service centers.

name: Infodrive Predictive
description: Machine-learning forecasting module that predicts parts demand, service load, and customer churn up to 90 days ahead, enabling proactive inventory and staffing decisions.

name: Intellegam Chat
description: Lightweight AI chat widget for dealer websites. Answers parts and service questions 24/7, captures leads, books appointments, and escalates to human agents when needed.
